question: (3-4sin² theta)/(cos² theta) can be simplified as :
solution:
**Given:**

 (3-4sin² θ)/(cos² θ)

**Calculation:**

 (3-4sin² θ)/(cos² θ)

⇒ (3/cos²θ) - (4sin²θ/cos²θ) 

⇒ 3sec²θ - 4tan²θ

⇒ 3sec2θ - 3tan2θ - tan2θ

⇒ 3(sec2θ - tan2θ) - tan2θ

⇒ 3 - tan2θ

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
